reviews.x: I am surprised why this product doesn't have any reviews. It's such an amazing case. Very sturdy and my styler fits so well in it. There is little extra space also , we can store a comb also along with it. There are many styler cases on the amazon but this is exactly same with less price. Must must buy.:)

reviews.t: Fits Dry Bar Double Shot Dryer Perfect
reviews.x: Got this case hoping my Dry Bar Double Shot blow dryer would fit. The dryer is on the expensive side and I just wanted a case to protect it and for travel. Not only does it fit great but the color matches perfectly like it was made for it. It’s very well made as well. Very happy with this purchase. You can’t beat the price.

Fits my revlon perfectly with a little room for small products like travel size heat protectant. The zipper pouch is perfect for my teasing brush and 6 clips. I have very please. I would recommend this product. Only down side it does have a slight odor. I sprayed it with some shout out and put it outside to air out for a few hours. Seems to do the trick.
I thought it was cheaply made but does the job. We will see how long it can last  Added: does not have a zippered pocket as shown!! Will return.

Nice and sturdy well made travel case for my combo hairbrush dryer.  Plenty of room so my dryer won't get smashed, plus it has a nice zipper pouch for my heat protection glove a comb, clips. Not sure how it will travel yet, but I'm sure it will do just fine.  Overall I'm happy with it.

reviews.t: great product -good use of space for extras
reviews.x: Other reviewers have noted the size, it is quite large but the hair dryer itself it also quite large. It measures 15 inches long. It has room for a comb, thermal protection spray and alligator clips so far. There is room for more items as well. It is built very sturdy and has double zippers. It is well worth the price. If you traveling and have a small suitcase it is quite bulky but so you may want to leave it home but if you can fit it, it's very worth it since you can fit a lot of other hair c

The perfect case! I can store my round brush blow dryer, 3 of my brushes, and two of my combs in here, the zipper compartment is where I stash all my hair ties, rubber bands, and my dozen of lip liners :) it’s a fantastic size and it’s well made.  I plan to order more to stash other items! Absolutely love that it’s sturdy and it holds its form.

reviews.t: Good for home use, too big for travel
reviews.x: I was hoping this case would be good for travel, but the size is a little too large and would take up too much room in my suitcase. There is additional room inside for other items which might make it ok for travel. I like the zippered mesh pouch for storing small items like hair clips. I really give this 3-1/2 stars because it doesn’t seem compact enough for travel, but it is sturdy. Unlike some other reviewers said, there was no weird smell. It fits the brush well. Note, this is ONLY THE CASE!
The product had a very distinct smell. Very smoky on the inside and outside of it. I couldn’t stand it so I have to return.
The case smells and the smell doesn’t go away.  It will make everything in your luggage smell.

reviews.t: Fits Bed Head One Step Dryer as well
reviews.x: Great storage/travel case.  I purchased the Bed Head One Step dryer, and was searching for a travel/case that it would fit in.  Fortunately, I saw a You tube video and the host supplied a link to this case and it just fits.  Highly recommend to protect the bristles from bending.

This case smells HORRIBLE on the inside! Like a mix of cigarette smoke and stale glue. It's gross! I'm returning it. I couldn't even handle having it in my bathroom, and would be so upset if my whole suitcase (and its contents) ended up smelling like that.
This works great to hold my Revlon Hair Dryer for traveling. It protects the bristles on the hair blower and neatly stores the cord and dryer. Light weight - perfect!

reviews.t: I can finally dry style my wet hair
reviews.x: I am probably late to the game with ceramic hair styling products.  I have thin, fine hair that goes limp in the coastal fog where I live.  I could spend more time than I cared to and get a nice style but it would fall limp again within a couple hours.  I could never master the technique of holding round brush in one hand and blow dryer in the other.  Besides, I'd need to blow dry first, in order to be able to actually roll the round brush thur my hair.  So fageddabout it.  A friend introduced m

reviews.t: Big sturdy traveling case for hair tools
reviews.x: I was not sure this would fit my hair tools. But once I got it I placed my chi curler and it fit with extra space. I actually tried to also place my revlon hairdryer/blow out brush and they both fit in it. The case didn’t break or damage. I love that I can fit both especially when traveling around. The case has a pocket with a zipper to keep small thin stuff inside like hit ties or manuals for your hair tools. That’s what I have. A plus that it has a handle on the case and that it comes in a nic

reviews.t: Great hard back case for hair styling tools.
reviews.x: Brought the gray case! It’s a nice hard back case. The Case prevents my hair blow dryer from bending bristle and keeping it still sturdy. It came with a zipper to put my hair clips and etc... I would like it to be a bit cheaper that’s why I took one star out for the value. But other than that it is really a nice case to put your hair styling tools in.

I didn't have a case before and traveled a lot with dogs. I had also dropped it a few times unpacking it lol, so I got this case that honestly was the best decision I made. Not only does it protect my blow dryer from drops, but it is also an amazing dust cover and is fashionable.

I bought this to go with my L’ange blowdrying brush and it fits perfectly. I recently used it in a checked suitcase and none of the bristles bent! It does the job well and I like that it has a small zipper pouch on the top for clips, Bobby pins, etc.

This is exactly what I was looking for! Great quality, sturdy, great protection for my hair tools. I was able to fit my drybar double shot blow dryer, my flat iron and my curler wand. I can travel with confidence!

Exactly as pictured and described.  Nice, rigid construction to protection your dryer.  I store my Dyson hair dryer and concentrator accessories inside with plenty of room.  There is also a mesh zipper pocket.
This carry case fits my Revlon hair dryer nicely. I travel a bit and I can see the benefit of it protecting the brush portion of the dryer. I knocked it down a star because to me it was a bit pricey.

reviews.t: Perfect for my Revlon One Step!
reviews.x: I use this case for my Revlon one step hair dryer, it's perfect for traveling! What I didn't like about the case is the funny smell it has, I am hoping it will go away soon!Perfect
the carrying case is exactly what i was looking for but the material had a horrible smell. I assume it's the adhesive or something. I eventually returned it because it was so bad.
I was able to fit the Revlon Dryer and my Drybar Crush Brush in the same case!  It does take up a good portion of your carry on, but at least your equipment is safe :)
I never got my blow dryer if this was a case only ya shoulda been very specific about it I saw some reviews with a blow dryer inside very confusing

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the case as sturdy and well made, with many noting it protects their styling tools well.
Many customers highlight the generous interior space and zippered pouch, which fit extra items like combs, clips, and brushes alongside the dryer.
A recurring complaint is a strong, unpleasant odor (described as smoky or like stale glue) that some reviewers say does not go away, prompting returns.
Several reviewers note the case fits specific dryers perfectly, including the Dry Bar Double Shot, Revlon, and Bed Head One Step.
Some reviewers find the case too large for travel or note it differs from the pictured product, including a missing zippered pocket.
